PM/GM at LEO Innovation LabDiagnosis App
Prototype smartphone app diagnosing skin conditions with machine learning		A moonshot: could a smartphone camera diagnose skin conditions? A 12-person team of data scientists, ML and computer vision engineers, wired for logic and certainty, in the deep uncertainty of product discovery. His first deep experience leading an ML team.Lead the product direction, prioritisation and strategy, and get a working prototype that could be evaluated.Worked with dermatologists to redesign closed-loop diagnosis and the ML training platform. Bootstrapped the ML engine with clinical decision trees. Designed the pipeline for data collection and analysis. Models were evaluated against a set of pre-tested images the dermatologists had all voted on. Not a medical device by design: disclaimers made clear it was not a diagnosis. Evaluated go-to-market and identified seven paths to market.Over 80% accuracy across three skin conditions.
